source: Refresh run Sun Nov 15, 2026 from an interactive Claude Code session (daily task disabled) — the first since Oct 24, so it covers three weeks of drift. Drained 6 pending actions: ratings for Helluva Boss S3 Part 1 (4.5★), Haunted Hotel S2 (4★) and Small Prophets Ep 5 (3★); hides for the Small Prophets and Scrubs trackers; and the Vox Machina S4 unpin. Those five shows leave the main page (Vox Machina moves to the bench; Small Prophets and Scrubs are gone entirely). Every active, critics and bench title was re-verified this session against JustWatch US (queried directly, including per-episode availability and offer end dates); weekly schedules were cross-checked against TVmaze, and review scores were re-read from Rotten Tomatoes today. Forward dates carry two sources unless labeled otherwise. Hero is Black Doves S2 (Netflix, Nov 5; 96% RT) — start with Season 1. New on the main page: Cunk on Cinema (landed today), Bass X Machina, Dead-End Job, Leviticus, Black Bag, Looper, Gail Daughtry and the Celebrity Sex Pass, North of North S2, plus The Rings of Power S3 and Rivals S2 Part 2 as weekly entries. Trackers advanced: The Lowdown S2 Ep 7 (finale Nov 25), Phony Ep 6, Where's Wanda? S2 Ep 5, Nocturne Ep 5. Finished since last time and moved to the bench as complete seasons: Dark Matter S2 (Oct 30), Taskmaster S22 (Nov 6), VisionQuest (Nov 10). Also moved to the bench: Carrie, Companion, Hokum, The Diplomat S4. Corrections vs. the Oct 24 file: Bridesmaids did leave Prime and is now on Netflix; Weapons is no longer on any of your platforms (dropped); Alien leaves Netflix Nov 30 (Aliens is also on Hulu); Brothers finished at 56% RT (dropped); JoJo's 2nd Stage is 11 episodes, not 12; the Slow Horses post-finale teaser claim couldn't be re-confirmed and was removed; Where's Wanda? S2 demoted to 'try' because it still has no reviews. Left out on purpose: 12 12 12 (Apple TV+, 63% RT) and Minimum Wage (teen-skewing, mixed reviews). New on the bench: The Body, Stick S2, Sew Torn (leaves Prime Dec 8), The Baltimorons, Heart Eyes, Carolina Caroline, Police Squad!, iZombie, The Nice Guys and The Wolf of Snow Hollow. Upcoming adds: Madden and Vienna Game (Wed), The Altruists (Thu), Percy Jackson S3 and The Blue Road (Fri), Blade Runner 2099 (Nov 25), Fool Night (Nov 26), Ray Gunn (Dec 18), Blue Eye Samurai S2 (Jan 19), Ahsoka S2 (Jan 20); Haunted Hotel S3 and Maximum Pleasure Guaranteed S2 were both renewed. Mickey 17's Hulu date and They Will Kill You on Prime are flagged unverified. Loved-list re-check: no new dates for Foundation S4, Severance S3, Black Mirror S8, Rick and Morty S10, The Last of Us S3 or Slow Horses S7; Silo S4 holds at Jul 9, 2027. One piece of bad news: The Boroughs, which you rated 4★, was cancelled after one season.

hero.title: Black Doves S2 — Full Season Live (6 eps)
hero.date: Thu Nov 5, 2026 — all 6 eps dropped at once; Season 1 (6 eps) is also on Netflix
hero.about: Joe Barton's London spy thriller returns. Helen Webb (Keira Knightley) is a politician's wife who has spent a decade passing his secrets to the Black Doves, a spies-for-hire outfit; Sam (Ben Whishaw) is the champagne-dry triggerman who keeps her alive. In Season 2 their handler Reed (Sarah Lancashire) has to fight off a plot against her own position inside the organisation. Sam Riley, Neve Campbell and Ambika Mod join the cast.
hero.why: The closest thing on your platforms to Slow Horses from your Loved list: a violent, very funny British spy thriller that runs on banter, with Whishaw's weary gay hitman as its heart. 96% on Rotten Tomatoes (26 reviews), Metascore 83 — critics say it improves on Season 1, with quibbles about an underused Neve Campbell and a few implausible twists; audiences are cooler at 65%. You haven't logged Season 1, which is also six episodes, also on Netflix, and set at Christmas — so start there. Twelve episodes in all.

new_this_week.title: Cunk on Cinema — New on Netflix (3 eps)
new_this_week.date: On Netflix since Sun Nov 15, 2026 — JustWatch and TVmaze both list three ~29-minute episodes (TVLine's preview said six); it premiered on BBC iPlayer Thu Nov 12
new_this_week.about: Diane Morgan is back as Philomena Cunk, the magnificently ill-informed presenter of Cunk on Earth, this time putting her hard-hitting questions to real experts on the history of cinema — from the invention of the camera through the New Wave to CGI and AI.
new_this_week.why: Dry British humour in its purest form — deadpan, absurd and finished in three half-hours, so the whole thing fits in one evening. Too new for a Tomatometer (one review so far); Cunk on Earth, also on Netflix, holds 100%. It landed Sunday, so it's the freshest thing on the page.

new_this_week.title: Bass X Machina — Full Season Live (6 eps)
new_this_week.date: Tue Nov 3, 2026 — all 6 eps dropped at once
new_this_week.about: LeSean Thomas (Cannon Busters, Yasuke) and Studio Mir reimagine lawman Bass Reeves in an alternate-history steampunk Old West: cybernetically enhanced and voiced by Brian Tyree Henry, he hunts outlaws, machines and supernatural terrors to protect his family. Janelle Monáe, Tati Gabrielle, Chaske Spencer and Cree Summer co-star.
new_this_week.why: Sci-fi, fantasy and the supernatural in one dense, built-out world — your top genres as adult animation, which you've been rating highly (Helluva Boss 4.5★, Haunted Hotel 4★). Fair warning: this one is an action-western played straight, not a comedy. 100% on Rotten Tomatoes (13 reviews), Metascore 82; critics single out the animation and Henry's grounded lead. Six ~35-minute episodes — two nights.

new_this_week.title: Dead-End Job — Full Season Live (8 eps)
new_this_week.date: Fri Oct 30, 2026 — all 8 eps dropped at once
new_this_week.about: Korean fantasy horror-comedy. Drowning in debt, Byeon Hyeok-jun (Lee Jae-wook) signs on with a mysterious agency that pays about fifty times the going rate for part-time work — starting with a convenience-store shift that comes with rules you really shouldn't break — and the gigs turn into a nightmare. Go Min-si, Kim Min-ha and Lee Hee-jun co-star.
new_this_week.why: Dark humour plus supernatural horror in sub-40-minute episodes — the combination you rate highest. 100% on Rotten Tomatoes, though from only 7 reviews; audiences sit at 74%. Critics like Lee Jae-wook and the mix of horror and workplace satire; the main complaint is that it holds its central mystery back too long. Korean, with subs or dubs.

new_this_week.title: The Lowdown S2 — Ep 7 'Hot Weeners!' (Wed Nov 18)
new_this_week.date: Wed Nov 18, 2026 — FX 9pm ET, on Hulu the same night per Disney (JustWatch has been logging episodes a day later, so check Thursday if it isn't up); 6 of 8 eps live; finale Ep 8 'The Tower' Wed Nov 25
new_this_week.about: Ethan Hawke returns as Lee Raybon, Tulsa's self-styled 'truthstorian'. After an award-winning exposé, he teams with a brash public defender (Betty Gilpin) to find her client, who vanished from prison — and the case pulls him back toward his estranged father (Tommy Lee Jones). From Reservation Dogs creator Sterlin Harjo. Six episodes are banked; Wednesday's is the penultimate one.
new_this_week.why: A funny, freewheeling neo-noir full of oddball characters — quirky humour over a twisty mystery. 100% on Rotten Tomatoes (16 reviews), Metascore 92, still the best-reviewed series on the slate; critics love the ensemble and say the central mystery is a notch below Season 1's. With the finale on Nov 25, starting now means no cliffhanger wait. Season 1 (8 eps) is on Hulu too.

new_this_week.title: Phony S1 — Ep 6 'I'm Right Here' (Tue Nov 17)
new_this_week.date: Tue Nov 17, 2026 on Hulu — weekly Tuesdays; 5 of 8 eps live; Ep 7 'What Comes Up?' Tue Nov 24; finale Ep 8 Tue Dec 1
new_this_week.about: After a car accident, teenager Sonny (Sam Nivola) is convinced his mother — who is also his high-school principal — has been replaced by an impostor. Connie Britton plays both versions of her. From Nick Paley (Marcel the Shell with Shoes On); Drew Goddard executive produces. Five episodes are banked.
new_this_week.why: Off-beat, quirky comedy with a real mystery engine in half-hour episodes. 93% on Rotten Tomatoes (15 reviews), Metascore 78 — the consensus calls it a smart twist on the coming-of-age story with standout performances. Five episodes is about two and a half hours, so you can be current before Tuesday.

new_this_week.title: Slow Horses S6 — Complete Season, Binge-Ready (finale aired Wed Oct 21)
new_this_week.date: All 6 eps live — finale Ep 6 'Judgement Day' dropped Wed Oct 21, 2026; S6 ran weekly Wednesdays Sep 16 – Oct 21
new_this_week.about: Season 6 adapts Mick Herron's Joe Country and Slough House: Diana Taverner drags the Slow Horses into a cycle of payback that puts the whole team on the run, with Lamb forced into an uneasy alliance while mercenaries close in. The six-episode run finished Oct 21; Season 7 (adapting Bad Actors) is expected in 2027.
new_this_week.why: Loved list — you rated the series 4★ — and you haven't logged Season 6 yet. It's complete, so it's a two- or three-night binge rather than a weekly wait. 98% on Rotten Tomatoes (42 reviews), Metascore 85. Critics' fair warning: the finale is the bleakest, most violent episode the show has made, and it ends on a cliffhanger.

new_this_week.title: Leviticus — New on Hulu
new_this_week.date: Added to Hulu Fri Nov 6, 2026 (JustWatch-verified Nov 15)
new_this_week.about: Australian supernatural horror from first-time feature director Adrian Chiarella. In a devout small town, two teenage boys (Joe Bird, Stacy Clausen) are hunted by a violent entity that takes the form of the person each of them desires most — each other. Mia Wasikowska co-stars.
new_this_week.why: Supernatural horror with an LGBTQ+ love story at its centre — two of your strongest signals in one tight 88 minutes. 92% on Rotten Tomatoes (178 reviews, Certified Fresh), audience score 82%.

new_this_week.title: Black Bag — New on Hulu
new_this_week.date: Added to Hulu Mon Nov 2, 2026 (JustWatch-verified Nov 15)
new_this_week.about: Steven Soderbergh's sleek spy caper, written by David Koepp: British intelligence officer George Woodhouse (Michael Fassbender) is handed a list of five colleagues who may be leaking a top-secret program — and his wife Kathryn (Cate Blanchett) is on it. Tom Burke, Marisa Abela, Regé-Jean Page, Naomie Harris and Pierce Brosnan co-star.
new_this_week.why: Slow Horses energy compressed into 94 minutes: dry wit, a dinner-party interrogation and a twist that pays off. 96% on Rotten Tomatoes (292 reviews, Certified Fresh).

new_this_week.title: Where's Wanda? S2 — Ep 5 'Friday' (Wed Nov 18)
new_this_week.date: Wed Nov 18, 2026 — weekly Wednesdays; 4 of 8 eps live; finale Ep 8 'Sunday' Wed Dec 9 (Apple TV press)
new_this_week.about: German dark-comedy mystery (subs or dubs). In Season 1 the Klatts bugged their entire suburb hunting for their missing daughter Wanda and uncovered every neighbour's secrets. Season 2 opened with Wanda found standing over a dead body; it's now at the halfway mark.
new_this_week.why: Off-beat dark humour with a real mystery engine — but Season 2 is flying blind critically: it has no Rotten Tomatoes reviews yet, and the one review located (from Italy) found it less sharp than Season 1. Season 1 (8 eps, also on Apple TV+) holds 100% from 7 reviews and is the place to start, which is why this is a 'try' this week.

new_this_week.title: The Rings of Power S3 — Eps 5 & 6 (Wed Nov 18)
new_this_week.date: Wed Nov 18, 2026 — two eps; Eps 1–4 dropped Wed Nov 11; finale Eps 7–8 Wed Nov 25 (Amazon + TVLine)
new_this_week.about: Season 3 jumps ahead to the height of the War of the Elves and Sauron, as the Dark Lord sets out to forge the One Ring. Four episodes are out ('Marnûkh', 'The Gift of Men', 'The Secret Fire', 'Gundabad'); two more land Wednesday and the last two the week after.
new_this_week.why: World-building on the largest scale going, and fantasy is one of your top genres — but the show's reputation for slow pacing is exactly what misses for you, hence 'try'. 81% on Rotten Tomatoes (37 reviews), Metascore 69: Nerdist calls it the best season yet, others say it still falls short; the Sauron storyline gets the praise and the dwarves the complaints. Episodes run about an hour, and Seasons 1–2 (16 eps) are on Prime if you need to catch up.

new_this_week.title: Nocturne — Ep 5 'Solitude' (Fri Nov 20)
new_this_week.date: Fri Nov 20, 2026 — weekly Fridays; 4 of 10 eps live since the two-ep premiere Fri Oct 30; finale Ep 10 Fri Dec 25
new_this_week.about: Rowan Joffe adapts Lars Kepler's Joona Linna novels. When a victim of imprisoned serial killer Jurek Walter (Stephen Graham) turns up alive, detective Jonah Lynn (Liev Schreiber) races to find the one person still missing while his protégée, FBI agent Saga Bauer (Zazie Beetz), goes undercover to get answers from Walter himself. Bill Camp and Rory Culkin co-star.
new_this_week.why: A prestige book adaptation in your suspense lane, built as a cat-and-mouse with twists. 85% on Rotten Tomatoes (40 reviews, Certified Fresh) — Stephen Graham's chilling killer gets most of the praise — but audiences are cooler (59%) and some critics find it convoluted. Dark with no comic relief, which is why it's a 'try'.

new_this_week.title: Rivals S2 — Ep 10 (Wed Nov 18)
new_this_week.date: Wed Nov 18, 2026 on Hulu — weekly Wednesdays; 9 of 12 eps live (Part 2 opened with Eps 7–9 on Wed Nov 11); finale Ep 12 Wed Dec 2
new_this_week.about: Jilly Cooper's 1980s Cotswolds bonkbuster: a ruthless TV-franchise war between Lord Tony Baddingham (David Tennant) and ex-Olympian MP Rupert Campbell-Black (Alex Hassell), fought with scandal, affairs and extremely British put-downs. Aidan Turner, Katherine Parkinson and Danny Dyer lead the ensemble. Season 3 is already ordered.
new_this_week.why: The best-reviewed thing airing that you haven't tried: 97% on Rotten Tomatoes (35 reviews), Metascore 87. It's a soap — glossy, horny and knowingly ridiculous — but the wit is dry and the ensemble is deep, which is your pocket. A catch-up proposition: Season 1 (8 eps) and the first nine of Season 2 are all on Hulu.

new_this_week.title: Gail Daughtry and the Celebrity Sex Pass — New on Netflix
new_this_week.date: On Netflix since Sat Nov 7, 2026 (JustWatch-verified Nov 15)
new_this_week.about: David Wain (Wet Hot American Summer, Role Models) directs. After her fiancé cashes in his 'celebrity pass', Kansas hairdresser Gail (Zoey Deutch) heads to Hollywood with her friend Otto to even the score with her own famous fantasy, Jon Hamm (playing himself) — with Italian assassins on their tail. John Slattery and Ken Marino co-star.
new_this_week.why: This week's comedy movie: a daffy, raunchy LA odyssey in the broad R-rated lane of The Heat and Spy from your Loved list. 78% on Rotten Tomatoes (148 reviews), Metascore 67; critics credit Deutch's charm, audiences are more split — so a 'try', but an easy 93 minutes.

new_this_week.title: Looper — New on Netflix
new_this_week.date: Added to Netflix Sun Nov 1, 2026 (JustWatch-verified Nov 15; no end date on the Netflix offer)
new_this_week.about: Rian Johnson's time-travel thriller: in 2044, Joe (Joseph Gordon-Levitt) is a hitman who disposes of targets sent back from the future — until the target that arrives is his own older self (Bruce Willis), who has no intention of dying. With Emily Blunt.
new_this_week.why: Sci-fi with a plot twist that pays off, from the director of the Knives Out films. 93% on Rotten Tomatoes (274 reviews). A two-hour movie night if you've never seen it — or haven't in a decade.

new_this_week.title: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 — Full 10-Ep Season Live
new_this_week.date: Tue Oct 20, 2026 — all 10 eps dropped at once
new_this_week.about: Studio Trigger and CD Projekt Red return to Night City in 2078 with an all-new cast: a young amateur filmmaker documenting street life gets pulled into the orbit of a vengeful nomad netrunner and a corporate runaway. Standalone — no need to have seen the 2022 series.
new_this_week.why: Your #1 genre with dense world-building and a mystery critics say pays off in the final act. 80% on Rotten Tomatoes (15 reviews), MAL 8.27. Two or three 28-minute episodes a night finishes it in a week.

new_this_week.title: North of North S2 — Full Season Live
new_this_week.date: Thu Nov 5, 2026 — all 8 eps on Netflix (it aired in Canada from September); Season 1 (8 eps) is also on Netflix
new_this_week.about: Comedy set in the tiny Arctic community of Ice Cove, Nunavut. Siaja (Anna Lambe), 27 and newly out of a bad marriage, is back living with her mother and rebuilding her life in a town where everyone knows everything. Season 2 follows her search for her sister.
new_this_week.why: A warm, quirky ensemble sitcom in 22-minute episodes — ideal before bed. 100% on Rotten Tomatoes (14 reviews), Metascore 83; the A.V. Club finds Season 2 sweeter and more assured. It's gentle rather than sarcastic, so a 'try' — and one to start from Season 1.

bench.title: Dark Matter S2 — Complete Season (10 eps)
bench.date: All 10 eps live — finale Ep 10 'No Quiet Life' dropped Fri Oct 30, 2026; Season 1 (9 eps) is also on Apple TV+
bench.about: Blake Crouch's multiverse thriller. After escaping to a seemingly safe dimension, Jason's obsession with the Box and Daniela's paranoia fracture the family's quiet life until a new threat forces them to run again.
bench.why: Foundation/Silo sci-fi pocket with novel-adaptation pedigree. 82% on Rotten Tomatoes (28 reviews), Metascore 76. The season finished on Oct 30, so all ten ~55-minute episodes are bingeable.

bench.title: Carrie — Full Season Live (Mike Flanagan)
bench.date: Wed Oct 7, 2026 — all 8 eps dropped at once
bench.about: Mike Flanagan reimagines Stephen King's debut: Carrie White, homeschooled in seclusion by her religious-extremist mother, is forced into public high school, where phone-amplified bullying collides with the telekinetic power she is only beginning to understand. Summer H. Howell and Samantha Sloyan lead.
bench.why: Horror/suspense, a novel adaptation and supernatural themes, with critics singling out the acting. 85% on Rotten Tomatoes (137 reviews), Metascore 71. Flanagan's slow-burn dread — give it two episodes.

bench.title: Companion — On Hulu
bench.date: On Hulu since Oct 18, 2026 (JustWatch-verified Nov 15)
bench.about: A weekend getaway at a remote lake house turns deadly once it's revealed that Iris (Sophie Thatcher), Josh's sweet girlfriend, is a companion robot — and she starts asking what she was built for. Jack Quaid, Harvey Guillén and Rupert Friend co-star; written and directed by Drew Hancock.
bench.why: Sci-fi horror with a sarcastic comic streak and twists that pay off — from the producers of Barbarian, which you rated 4★. 93% on Rotten Tomatoes (265 reviews), Metascore 70. A tidy 97-minute movie night.

bench.title: Hokum — On Hulu
bench.date: On Hulu since Oct 10, 2026 (JustWatch-verified Nov 15)
bench.about: Horror novelist Ohm Bauman (Adam Scott) travels to a remote Irish inn where his parents honeymooned to scatter their ashes. The honeymoon suite is said to be haunted by a witch, and when a staff member disappears he is pulled into nightmarish visions of his own past. From Damian McCarthy (Oddity).
bench.why: Severance's Adam Scott in a folk-horror mystery with well-timed shocks — supernatural, twisty and a tidy 107 minutes. 90% on Rotten Tomatoes (209 reviews, Certified Fresh), Metascore 76.

bench.title: The Diplomat S4 — Full Season Live
bench.date: Thu Oct 15, 2026 — all 8 eps dropped at once
bench.about: Political thriller with a screwball-marriage streak. A catastrophic moment shatters the US–UK peace Ambassador Kate Wyler brokered and strains her marriage, while President Grace Penn and new VP Hal Wyler scheme over Russia's most powerful weapon. Keri Russell, Rufus Sewell, Allison Janney, Bradley Whitford.
bench.why: Rapid-fire banter, twists that pay off and a top-tier ensemble — Slow Horses energy in Washington. 97% on Rotten Tomatoes (29 reviews), Metascore 90. You haven't logged S1–S3 (22 eps, all on Netflix), so treat it as a start-from-the-top series.

bench.title: Taskmaster S22 — Complete on Hulu (10 eps)
bench.date: All 10 eps on Hulu — the finale, 'Big, clumsy emu steps', landed Fri Nov 6, 2026
bench.format: series — comedy panel show, 10 eps, complete
bench.about: Greg Davies and Alex Horne set five comedians absurd, ingenious tasks. Series 22's line-up: Richard Ayoade, Matt Lucas, Nina Conti, Isy Suttie and Chloe Petts.
bench.why: Dry British humour at its most absurd, and every episode stands alone — easy to drop into before bed. Ayoade's deadpan alone is worth it. The series is now complete; episodes run about 46 minutes.

bench.title: Bridesmaids — Now on Netflix
bench.date: On Netflix since Sun Nov 1, 2026 (JustWatch-verified Nov 15); it left Prime Video at the end of October
bench.about: Broke and spiraling, Annie (Kristen Wiig) becomes maid of honor for her best friend (Maya Rudolph) and wages a one-sided war with the bride's perfect new friend (Rose Byrne). Melissa McCarthy steals every scene.
bench.why: The Paul Feig + Melissa McCarthy team behind The Heat and Spy on your Loved list, in the same sarcastic, banter-heavy register. 89% on Rotten Tomatoes (294 reviews), Metascore 75.

bench.title: The Legend of Vox Machina — S4 (Complete, 12 eps)
bench.date: All 12 eps live on Prime (season completed Wed Jun 24, 2026); Season 5, the final one, has no date yet
bench.about: The animated Critical Role adaptation's fourth season: a year after the Chroma Conclave's defeat, Vox Machina have scattered to chase love, family and purpose until a long-dormant evil stirs. Ends on 'The Ascension'.
bench.why: 100% on Rotten Tomatoes (15 reviews), Metascore 84 — the best-reviewed season yet. Fantasy, gods and sarcastic banter in 26-minute episodes. You unpinned it on Oct 28, so it lives here now rather than on the main page.

bench.title: The Body — Full Season Live (8 eps)
bench.date: Wed Nov 11, 2026 — all 8 eps dropped at once
bench.about: From Quinn Shephard (Under the Bridge). In 2004, a Halloween initiation for a Catholic-school dance troupe goes wrong and new girl Grace ends up in a coma — and as the girls start reporting prophetic visions, the whole town tips into hysteria. Kristina Bogic, Sara Boustany and Shirley Chen lead, with Nnamdi Asomugha as the school's priest.
bench.why: Spooky Catholic horror with a queer storyline and some wry humour — think Mean Girls crossed with The Crucible. 86% on Rotten Tomatoes (22 reviews), Metascore 73, and a 98% audience score. Critics' caveat: it runs long and the ending doesn't fully land, and it's teen-centred, so a 'try'.

bench.title: Stick S2 — Ep 4 'The Boog' (Wed Nov 18)
bench.date: Wed Nov 18, 2026 — weekly Wednesdays; 3 of 10 eps live since the two-ep premiere Wed Nov 4; finale Ep 10 Wed Dec 30
bench.about: Owen Wilson is Pryce Cahill, a golfer whose career ended in an on-course meltdown and who goes all in on mentoring Santi (Peter Dager), a teenage phenom. Marc Maron and Mariana Treviño co-star; Season 2 is three episodes in.
bench.why: Half-hour comfort comedy with a strong ensemble: Season 2 is at 100% on Rotten Tomatoes (13 reviews), Metascore 72, and RogerEbert.com calls it a big step up. It's the feel-good sports-comedy family of Ted Lasso, whose S4 premiere you hid — so only a 'try'. Season 1 (10 eps) is on Apple TV+.

bench.title: Sew Torn — On Prime Video (leaves Dec 8)
bench.date: Included with Prime since Tue Nov 10, 2026; JustWatch shows the Prime offer itself ending Tue Dec 8 (JustWatch-verified Nov 15)
bench.about: A mobile seamstress (Eve Connolly) in the Swiss Alps stumbles on a drug deal gone bad and a briefcase of cash, and the film plays out her different choices in turn — each leading somewhere drastically different, and each relying on her elaborate needle-and-thread contraptions. John Lynch and Calum Worthy co-star.
bench.why: An off-beat little crime caper with a clever structure and twists that pay off in 100 minutes. 95% on Rotten Tomatoes (42 reviews); audiences are cooler at 68%. It's on Prime for four weeks only.

bench.title: The Baltimorons — New on Hulu
bench.date: Added to Hulu Fri Nov 13, 2026 (JustWatch-verified Nov 15)
bench.about: Jay Duplass directs. On Christmas Eve a newly sober man (Michael Strassner) cracks a tooth, and the emergency dentist who treats him (Liz Larsen) ends up spending the whole strange, increasingly romantic night with him across Baltimore.
bench.why: A low-key, off-beat comedy with real warmth under the awkwardness — a good one to hold for the holidays. 93% on Rotten Tomatoes (75 reviews), 84% audience. More gentle than sarcastic, hence 'try'.

bench.title: Heart Eyes — New on Hulu
bench.date: Added to Hulu Mon Nov 9, 2026 (JustWatch-verified Nov 15)
bench.about: A slasher wearing a rom-com's clothes: two co-workers (Olivia Holt, Mason Gooding) stuck working late on Valentine's Day are mistaken for a couple by the Heart Eyes Killer, who only hunts lovers. Directed by Josh Ruben.
bench.why: Horror with a sarcastic comic streak in 97 minutes. 78% on Rotten Tomatoes (181 reviews), 76% audience — fun rather than essential.

bench.title: Carolina Caroline — New on Netflix
bench.date: On Netflix since Fri Nov 6, 2026 (JustWatch-verified Nov 15)
bench.about: A restless West Texas woman (Samara Weaving) runs off with a charming con man (Kyle Gallner) to look for her estranged mother; their small scams escalate into bank robberies across the Southeast. Directed by Adam Rehmeier, with Kyra Sedgwick.
bench.why: A lovers-on-the-run crime story with real momentum: 90% on Rotten Tomatoes (84 reviews), Metascore 75, with the leads' chemistry getting the credit. Not a comedy and outside your top genres, so a 'try' for a thriller night.

bench.title: Police Squad! — New on Netflix (Complete Series)
bench.date: Added to Netflix Sun Nov 1, 2026 — all 6 eps, the only season made (JustWatch-verified Nov 15)
bench.about: The 1982 cop-show parody from the Airplane! team, with Leslie Nielsen as the gloriously oblivious Det. Frank Drebin. Cancelled after six episodes, it was reborn on film as The Naked Gun.
bench.why: Deadpan absurdism at maximum joke density, in six 24-minute episodes — two and a half hours for the whole series, and one of the most rewatchable comedies ever made.

bench.title: iZombie — Complete Series on Prime
bench.date: All 5 seasons (71 eps) included with Prime since Sun Nov 1, 2026 (JustWatch-verified Nov 15)
bench.about: Over-achieving med resident Liv Moore (Rose McIver) is turned into a zombie, takes a job at the morgue for the brains, and finds that eating them gives her the victims' memories and personalities — so she helps a detective solve their murders. From Veronica Mars creator Rob Thomas, loosely based on the Vertigo comic.
bench.why: Supernatural premise, quippy banter and a case-of-the-week mystery — light, funny and very bingeable. 92% on Rotten Tomatoes across the series. A 71-episode commitment at 42 minutes each, so a 'try' for when you want a long comfort watch.

bench.title: The Nice Guys — On Apple TV+
bench.date: On Apple TV+ since Sun Nov 1, 2026 (JustWatch-verified Nov 15) — a licensed film, so likely a limited stay, though JustWatch shows no end date on Apple's own offer
bench.about: Los Angeles, 1977: a hapless private eye (Ryan Gosling) and a bruiser-for-hire (Russell Crowe) get tangled in the case of a missing girl and a dead porn star. Written and directed by Shane Black.
bench.why: Sarcastic buddy comedy with a twisty mystery under it — the same banter-first register as The Heat and Spy on your Loved list, and Gosling's funniest performance. 91% on Rotten Tomatoes (327 reviews).

bench.title: The Wolf of Snow Hollow — On Prime Video
bench.date: Included with Prime since Sun Nov 1, 2026; the Prime offer runs to Jan 1, 2027 (JustWatch-verified Nov 15)
bench.about: Bodies start turning up after every full moon in a Utah ski town, and the deputy on the case (writer-director Jim Cummings) — a recovering alcoholic with a temper — unravels faster than the mystery does. Riki Lindhome co-stars, with Robert Forster in his final role.
bench.why: A dark comedy disguised as a werewolf whodunit, done in 85 minutes. 90% on Rotten Tomatoes (78 reviews); audiences are more divided (62%), mostly over its abrasive lead.

bench.title: Last Seen — Complete 6-Ep Series
bench.date: All 6 eps live — finale Ep 6 'The Choice' dropped Wed Oct 7, 2026
bench.about: Australian missing-child thriller adapting Ryan David Jahn's The Dispatcher. Ian Ridley (Patrick Brammall), an ex-detective turned police dispatcher, has spent 11 years refusing to accept his daughter is gone — until a call comes in. Maxine Peake co-stars.
bench.why: Character-first prestige thriller in the Slow Horses / Silo pocket; critics say the mystery pays off. 88% on Rotten Tomatoes (25 reviews), Metascore 78. Six episodes — a long weekend.

bench.title: Firefly Wedding — Ep 7 (Fri Nov 20)
bench.date: Fri Nov 20, 2026 (~9am PT) — Crunchyroll simulcast, weekly Fridays; 6 of 12 eps live (Ep 6 'Honest Feelings' aired Fri Nov 13); finale projected Fri Dec 25
bench.about: Meiji-era noblewoman Satoko Kirigaya is terminally ill and wants to marry well before she dies. When the assassin Shinpei Gotō kidnaps her, she talks her way out by proposing marriage — and he takes the vow dead seriously. From David Production (JoJo).
bench.why: A twisty premise, dark humor layered over a tight thriller, and 23-minute episodes; six banked eps is a two-evening catch-up. LiveChart 7.8, and it ranked #2 in Anime Corner's week-6 fall poll.

bench.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Steel Ball Run — Ep 10 (Fri Nov 20)
bench.date: Fri Nov 20, 2026 — weekly Fridays on Netflix; 9 of 12 eps live (the March premiere plus eight of the 11-episode 2nd Stage); finale Fri Dec 4
bench.about: 1890: a cross-continental horse race from San Diego to New York with a $50 million purse. Paraplegic ex-jockey Johnny Joestar enters after a brush with Gyro Zeppeli, whose spinning steel balls briefly let Johnny stand.
bench.why: Camp, off-beat humor and supernatural powers in an alternate-history America — a fresh jumping-on point for the franchise. IMDb 9.3; the run wraps Dec 4, so it will be bingeable in three weeks.

bench.title: The Terminal List S2 — Full Season Live
bench.date: Wed Oct 21, 2026 — all 8 eps dropped at once
bench.about: Ex-SEAL James Reece (Chris Pratt), having finished the revenge list from Season 1, is pulled back from exile into a new covert mission — adapting Jack Carr's True Believer. Constance Wu and Tom Hopper co-star.
bench.why: Grim and humorless, so outside your top genres, but a novel adaptation with conspiracy twists in the Man on Fire lane you rated 4★. Critics are cool (57% RT, 7 reviews) while audiences are warm (89%). A 'try' for an action week.

bench.title: Save Yourselves! — On Netflix
bench.date: On Netflix since Oct 10, 2026 (JustWatch-verified Nov 15)
bench.about: A Brooklyn couple (Sunita Mani, John Reynolds) unplug at an upstate cabin for a week and completely miss that Earth is being invaded by small, fuzzy, deceptively cute aliens. With John Early and Amy Sedaris.
bench.why: Dark humor plus sci-fi in a quick 93 minutes — a dry, quirky two-hander in the Search Party register. 89% on Rotten Tomatoes (91 reviews); audiences are cooler, so expect low-key laughs rather than big set pieces.

bench.title: Wayne S1 — On Netflix (Complete Series)
bench.date: On Netflix since Oct 12, 2026 — all 10 eps; the only season made (JustWatch-verified Nov 15)
bench.about: A kind-hearted 16-year-old with a hair-trigger sense of justice and his crush ride a dirt bike from Massachusetts to Florida to steal back his late dad's 1979 Trans Am. Hyper-violent, foul-mouthed and unexpectedly tender; from the Deadpool writers.
bench.why: Sarcastic dark comedy with real heart in 33-minute episodes. 100% on Rotten Tomatoes (13 reviews), 95% audience. One season only — it was cancelled — but reviews call the ending satisfying.

bench.title: Nobody Wants This S3 — Full Season Live
bench.date: Thu Oct 22, 2026 — all 10 eps dropped at once; S1–S2 (20 eps) also on Netflix
bench.about: An agnostic podcaster (Kristen Bell) and a rabbi (Adam Brody) make it work across very different worlds and two meddling families. Season 3 moves them in together; Timothy Simons and Justine Lupe get more to do, and Andrew Rannells and Sarah Silverman join.
bench.why: Fast banter and a sharp ensemble in 27-minute episodes. 87% on Rotten Tomatoes (15 reviews), Metascore 75. Romance-forward rather than your core genres, and you'd be starting from S1 (30 eps total), so a 'try'.

bench.title: Lupin Part 4 — Full Season Live
bench.date: Fri Oct 23, 2026 — all 8 eps dropped at once; Parts 1–3 (17 eps) also on Netflix
bench.about: Gentleman thief Assane Diop (Omar Sy) is serving his sentence when a copycat 'Lupin' announces simultaneous museum heists across Paris and frames him — so he breaks out to take up the persona one more time. Inspired by Maurice Leblanc's Arsène Lupin novels; French with an English dub.
bench.why: Twists that pay off and pure escapism; the series holds 98% on Rotten Tomatoes and Part 4 is 100% on early reviews (Metascore 78). Part 4 picks up straight from Part 3's ending, so it's a from-the-top commitment if you haven't started.

bench.title: Rooster Fighter S1 — On Netflix
bench.date: All 12 eps on Netflix since Oct 10, 2026 (also on Hulu) (JustWatch-verified Nov 15)
bench.about: Towering demons called Kiju invade Japan, and the last line of defense is Keiji — a lone rooster with razor-sharp spurs hunting the White Demon that killed his sister. A straight-faced, gory action parody.
bench.why: Absurdist premise played completely deadpan, demon mythology, 24-minute episodes. Reviews are thin (IMDb 7.0), so sample one episode before committing.

bench.title: Good Fortune — On Prime Video
bench.date: Included with Prime since Aug 21, 2026 (JustWatch-verified Nov 15; no end date on the Prime offer)
bench.about: Aziz Ansari's directorial debut: Gabriel (Keanu Reeves), a low-ranking guardian angel whose actual job is stopping people from texting while driving, swaps broke gig worker Arj (Ansari) into the life of a rich tech guy (Seth Rogen) to teach him a lesson. Keke Palmer and Sandra Oh round out the cast.
bench.why: Off-beat humor, a heaven-bureaucracy premise that is the closest film cousin to Good Omens, and an ensemble cast. 79% on Rotten Tomatoes (150 reviews), 80% audience.

bench.title: VisionQuest — Complete Limited Series (8 eps)
bench.date: All 8 eps on Disney+ — the finale, 'Forever', landed Tue Nov 10, 2026
bench.about: The final part of the WandaVision trilogy: Paul Bettany's White Vision, carrying the original Vision's memories, goes on the run with Wanda's son Tommy while a killer called the Butcherbird hunts them — and inside his mind, Ultron (James Spader) and a crew of retired Stark AIs fight for control. From Terry Matalas (Star Trek: Picard S3).
bench.why: Sci-fi world-building with a mystery engine and Diane Morgan's dry humour among the AIs. 86% on Rotten Tomatoes (131 reviews) and 85% audience now that it's complete; best if you've seen WandaVision.

bench.title: Below — 6-Ep Limited Series
bench.date: Live since Thu Oct 8, 2026 — all 6 eps out
bench.about: In a Newfoundland fishing town, a stubborn fisherman (Josh Hartnett) still haunted by his father's mysterious death has to hold his family and community together when an unidentified giant sea creature starts attacking. Mackenzie Davis and Charlie Heaton co-star.
bench.why: Jaws-style creature suspense in six 40-minute episodes. Critics give it 88% (50 reviews) but audiences only 51%, citing an uneven back half — a 'try'.

bench.title: What We Do in the Shadows — Complete Series on Hulu
bench.date: All 6 seasons (61 eps) on Hulu — JustWatch-verified Nov 15
bench.about: Mockumentary about four centuries-old vampire roommates — one an 'energy vampire' who bores people to death — and their long-suffering human familiar, fumbling through modern life on Staten Island. Developed by Jemaine Clement from his and Taika Waititi's film.
bench.why: Dark supernatural comedy, deadpan absurdist humour, 25-minute episodes and a great ensemble — about as close to a sure thing as the catalog gets. 96% on Rotten Tomatoes (222 reviews).

bench.title: Dandadan S1–S2
bench.date: Both seasons (24 eps) on Crunchyroll and Netflix — JustWatch-verified Nov 15; Season 3 due 2027
bench.about: A girl who believes in ghosts and an occult-obsessed classmate who believes in aliens dare each other to prove it — and both turn out to be right. A chaotic mix of yokai, UFOs, awkward teen romance and gonzo action-comedy from Science SARU.
bench.why: Supernatural plus sci-fi, fast off-beat comedy and Demon Slayer-level action animation in 24-minute episodes. 100% on Rotten Tomatoes (25 reviews). Expect some crude running gags.

bench.title: Pluribus S1 — On Apple TV+
bench.date: All 9 eps on Apple TV+ (aired Nov–Dec 2025); Season 2 reportedly began filming Oct 31, 2026 — no date
bench.about: In Albuquerque, a cranky romance novelist (Rhea Seehorn) is one of the few people left unaffected when a mysterious event turns the rest of humanity into a blissfully content collective — and she may be the only one who wants to undo it. From Vince Gilligan.
bench.why: High-concept sci-fi with a sardonic lead and mystery twists, in the Severance vein you love. 99% on Rotten Tomatoes (123 reviews), Metascore 87 — a deliberate slow burn, and audiences are split.

bench.title: Russian Doll S1–S2 — On Netflix
bench.date: Both seasons (15 eps) on Netflix — JustWatch-verified Nov 15
bench.about: A sardonic New York game developer (Natasha Lyonne) keeps dying on the night of her 36th birthday party and waking up at the start of the same evening. Season 2 moves the puzzle to time travel through the subway.
bench.why: Dark humour plus sci-fi, a quick-witted lead and a puzzle box that pays off, in 28-minute episodes. 97% on Rotten Tomatoes (166 reviews). Season 2 gets more abstract.

bench.title: Daemons of the Shadow Realm S1 — Complete
bench.date: All 24 eps on Crunchyroll (aired Apr–Sep 2026); also on Netflix and Hulu; Season 2 announced, no date
bench.about: Yuru, a young hunter from a remote mountain village, watches outsiders attack his home — and one of them looks exactly like his sister Asa. Bonded to two powerful daemons, he heads into the outside world to learn which Asa is real. From Fullmetal Alchemist creator Hiromu Arakawa; animated by Bones.
bench.why: Fantasy mythology with a mystery hook and humour balancing the action, in 23-minute episodes — the supernatural action-fantasy pocket Demon Slayer fills. No critic consensus yet (IMDb 7.7).

bench.title: Wake Up Dead Man: A Knives Out Mystery
bench.date: On Netflix since Dec 12, 2025 (JustWatch-verified Nov 15)
bench.about: Benoit Blanc's third case: a seemingly impossible death tied to a small-town church and its fiercely loyal congregation. Daniel Craig, Josh O'Connor, Glenn Close, Josh Brolin and Andrew Scott.
bench.why: Twists that pay off, witty banter and a stacked ensemble — the darkest Knives Out yet and still very funny. 92% on Rotten Tomatoes (344 reviews), Metascore 80. Long at 2h 25m.

bench.title: The Fall of the House of Usher — Limited Series
bench.date: All 8 eps on Netflix — JustWatch-verified Nov 15
bench.about: The heirs of a ruthless pharmaceutical dynasty start dying one by one, and its aging founders are forced to reckon with the bargain that built their fortune. Mike Flanagan weaves Edgar Allan Poe's stories into one gothic family saga.
bench.why: Supernatural horror from a literary source, with a great ensemble and pitch-black humour about the corrupt rich. 91% on Rotten Tomatoes (114 reviews). Pairs naturally with Flanagan's Carrie.

bench.title: Derry Girls S1–S3 — On Netflix
bench.date: All 19 eps on Netflix — JustWatch-verified Nov 15
bench.about: Five Catholic-school teens — including one nervous English cousin — get through exams, crushes and family chaos in 1990s Northern Ireland during the Troubles. Created by Lisa McGee.
bench.why: Rapid-fire, sarcastic banter and dry Irish humour from a great ensemble, with real substance under the farce — close to Fleabag territory. 99% on Rotten Tomatoes (87 reviews).

bench.title: Arcane S1–S2 — On Netflix
bench.date: Both seasons (18 eps) on Netflix — JustWatch-verified Nov 15
bench.about: Two orphaned sisters end up on opposite sides of a war between gleaming Piltover and its oppressed undercity, Zaun, sparked by a volatile new magic technology. A painterly steampunk-fantasy epic from the League of Legends universe.
bench.why: Rich world-building, a strong voice ensemble and twists that land, complete in two seasons. 100% on Rotten Tomatoes (65 reviews). Darker and more tragic than your comedy picks.

bench.title: Hit Man — On Netflix
bench.date: On Netflix since Jun 2024 (JustWatch-verified Nov 15)
bench.about: A mild-mannered New Orleans philosophy professor moonlights as a fake contract killer in police stings, inventing a new persona for every client — until he falls for a woman who wants to hire him. Glen Powell and Adria Arjona; directed by Richard Linklater.
bench.why: Witty banter, an off-beat premise and a light tone with a dark edge. 95% on Rotten Tomatoes (303 reviews), Metascore 82.

bench.title: FROM S1–S3 — On Netflix (limited-time license)
bench.date: On Netflix since Mon Oct 19, 2026 — 30 eps (S1–S3) under a limited-time license; no end date on the Netflix offer (JustWatch-verified Nov 15)
bench.about: Residents of a middle-American town can't leave — every road loops back — and after dark, monsters that look human come knocking. Harold Perrineau leads the trapped survivors as they dig into the town's buried mythology.
bench.why: Supernatural mystery-box horror with deep world-building; 96% on Rotten Tomatoes across the series. A heavy, humorless slow burn and a 30-episode commitment, so a 'try'. Season 4 is MGM+-only.

bench.title: The Gentlemen S2 — Full Season on Netflix
bench.date: Live since Thu Sep 3, 2026 — all 8 eps out (finale 'Bring Me the Head'); Season 3 renewed Aug 24, no date
bench.about: A year after Eddie Horniman (Theo James) and Susie Glass (Kaya Scodelario) went into business with Bobby Glass, the duo expand the cannabis empire into Italy while Bobby's increasingly unsound decisions threaten the whole operation.
bench.why: You rated S1 4.5★. Season 2 holds 87% on Rotten Tomatoes (30 reviews), Metascore 70 — dry British humor plus crime, squarely in your pocket. It dropped in September, so it lives on the bench, but it is still unwatched.

bench.title: Neagley — Full Season on Prime
bench.date: Live since Wed Sep 16, 2026 — all 8 eps out; renewed for S2 (no date)
bench.about: Reacher spin-off: former Army investigator Frances Neagley (Maria Sten), now a Chicago PI, learns a childhood friend has died in a suspicious accident and follows the trail to a cult at a pharmaceutical compound.
bench.why: 94% on Rotten Tomatoes (34 reviews), Certified Fresh — the best-reviewed start in the Reacher universe. A straight action-crime procedural, so 'try' rather than strong.

bench.title: Mayday
bench.date: Streaming on Apple TV+ since Fri Sep 4, 2026
bench.about: 1987: a cocky US Navy pilot (Ryan Reynolds) shot down over the USSR is found by a weary ex-KGB officer (Kenneth Branagh), and the two bicker their way across Soviet territory. From the Game Night directors.
bench.why: Mismatched-buddy comedy with a Cold War spine — next door to Spy, The Heat and Planes, Trains & Automobiles on your loved list. 83% on Rotten Tomatoes (106 reviews).

bench.title: Adults S2 — Full Season on Hulu
bench.date: Live since Thu Aug 27, 2026 — all 8 eps out (finale 'Vote for Paul Baker')
bench.about: FX hangout sitcom: five twentysomething friends share Samir's childhood home in Queens and bumble through work, dating, health scares and friendship. Season 2 is the one critics call a big step up.
bench.why: 100% on Rotten Tomatoes (27 reviews), 96% audience, Metascore 79. Fast ensemble banter in 25-minute episodes — a close cousin of Extraordinary, which you rated 4★.

bench.title: Chad Powers S2 — Full Season on Hulu
bench.date: Live since Thu Sep 3, 2026 — all 6 eps out (ends on '12th Quarter')
bench.about: Glen Powell's disguise-as-a-walk-on-QB comedy. In Season 2 Chad is a superstar on the field, but his odd off-field behavior has everyone suspicious.
bench.why: 93% on Rotten Tomatoes (15 reviews) — a big jump on S1. Broad disguise-gag humor, so a 'try' for a low-lift comedy week.

bench.title: Alien (1979) — Last Chance on Netflix (leaves Nov 30)
bench.date: On Netflix through Mon Nov 30, 2026 — JustWatch shows the Netflix offer itself ending that day (JustWatch-verified Nov 15)
bench.about: Ridley Scott's original sci-fi horror aboard the Nostromo.
bench.why: Two top genres at once; 93% RT, Metascore 89. Slow-burn first act, so pick a night you want dread — and make it this month, because it leaves Netflix on Nov 30.

bench.title: Aliens (1986) — On Hulu
bench.date: On Hulu since Mon Nov 2, 2026 (JustWatch-verified Nov 15); the Netflix copy leaves Nov 30
bench.about: James Cameron's sequel — the action turn on the sci-fi horror.
bench.why: Companion to Alien for a two-night pairing; 93% RT, Metascore 84.

bench.title: Stavros Halkias: Uncle Stav
bench.date: Live since Tue Sep 8, 2026 — 64-min stand-up special
bench.about: Halkias's second Netflix hour, taped in his hometown Baltimore: newly an uncle, he leans into being the dirtbag uncle who can still be a role model.
bench.why: One-hour comedy palate cleanser; raunchier than your dry/witty register, so 'try'.

bench.title: Sam Morril: Incorrect
bench.date: Live since Tue Sep 29, 2026 — 47-min stand-up special
bench.about: Sam Morril's second Netflix set: his worst one-night stand, a riff comparing famous assassinations and an unorthodox rat extermination.
bench.why: Dry, deadpan and under 50 minutes — a bedtime-sized comedy slot.

bench.title: Party Down S1–S3 — On Netflix
bench.date: Streaming on Netflix since Tue Sep 22, 2026 — all 26 eps (10/10/6)
bench.about: Struggling actors and writers wait for their big break while stuck serving hors d'oeuvres for a Hollywood catering company — a different disastrous event every episode. Adam Scott, Ken Marino, Martin Starr, Jane Lynch, Lizzy Caplan.
bench.why: 93% on Rotten Tomatoes (86 reviews) — bone-dry ensemble comedy in 29-minute bites, with Severance's Adam Scott; the whole run is now in one place.

bench.title: Hereditary — On Hulu
bench.date: On Hulu since Oct 1, 2026 (JustWatch-verified Nov 15); the Prime Video copy leaves Dec 1
bench.about: After the death of the family's secretive matriarch, Annie Graham (Toni Collette) and her family are haunted by increasingly disturbing events that peel back a sinister occult inheritance. Ari Aster's debut.
bench.why: 90% on Rotten Tomatoes (385 reviews), Metascore 87. Supernatural horror with a twist that pays off — deliberate pacing, so save it for a night you want dread, not banter.

bench.title: The Substance — On Hulu
bench.date: On Hulu since Oct 2, 2026 (JustWatch-verified Nov 15)
bench.about: Coralie Fargeat's body-horror satire: a fading TV fitness star (Demi Moore) takes a black-market serum that spawns a younger, 'better' version of herself (Margaret Qualley), and the two must swap control every seven days. It gets very graphic in the back half.
bench.why: 89% on Rotten Tomatoes (380 reviews), Metascore 78. Dark humor + sci-fi + horror in one sitting; skip if you want light before bed.

bench.title: My Sad Dead — 4-Ep Miniseries
bench.date: Live since Thu Sep 24, 2026 — all 4 eps out
bench.about: Pablo Larraín adapts Mariana Enriquez: Ema (Mercedes Morán), a retired Buenos Aires doctor who has always been able to see the dead, is pulled back into that world by her unstable niece. Four episodes, subtitled from Spanish.
bench.why: 80% on Rotten Tomatoes (10 reviews). Fits your horror/supernatural chip in a four-night commitment; critics flag slow pacing and a grim tone, so 'try'.

bench.title: Mononoke the Movie: Chapter III – The Curse of the Serpent
bench.date: On Netflix since Tue Sep 29, 2026 (JustWatch-verified Nov 15); Chapters I and II are also on Netflix
bench.about: The wandering Medicine Seller, an exorcist who hunts mononoke — spirits spawned from human passions and grudges — returns to the women's quarters of Edo Castle for the trilogy's finale.
bench.why: Supernatural/mythology anime in a one-sitting 88 minutes; covers the horror + anime chips. Third of three films, so start with Chapters I–II (about three hours) if you haven't seen them.

bench.title: Re:ZERO S4 — Complete Season on Crunchyroll
bench.date: All 19 eps on Crunchyroll, ending with the ~45-minute 'Shaula / Hero' (JustWatch-verified Nov 15); a fifth season is announced, no date
bench.about: Subaru, who can 'Return by Death' to a checkpoint each time he dies, heads into the Pleiades Watchtower and then the Recapture Arc. Season 4 is now complete and binge-ready.
bench.why: Fantasy world-building and a time-loop structure built on twists — but it is a continuity-heavy fourth season (85 episodes deep), so only a 'try' unless you've seen S1–S3.

bench.title: The Apothecary Diaries S3 — Ep 8 (Fri Nov 20)
bench.date: Fri Nov 20, 2026 — weekly Fridays on Crunchyroll since Oct 2; 7 eps out (Ep 7 aired Fri Nov 13); Part 1 ends with Ep 12 on Fri Dec 18, Part 2 follows in April 2027. JustWatch lists Season 3 only under the Crunchyroll Amazon Channel, and Crunchyroll's own page couldn't be reached this session
bench.about: Maomao, a sharp-tongued apothecary's daughter kidnapped into service in the imperial rear palace, solves poisonings and court intrigues with pharmacology and deadpan logic. Season 3 picks up after the Shi clan arc.
bench.why: Mystery-of-the-week structure with a dry, sarcastic lead and 24-minute episodes; IMDb 8.6 and the most popular show of the fall season in CBR's mid-term poll. You haven't logged S1–S2 (48 eps, also on Crunchyroll), so this is a catch-up proposition rather than a tracker.

bench.title: Ranma ½ (2024) S3 — Ep 8 (Sat Nov 21)
bench.date: Sat Nov 21, 2026 — weekly Saturdays on Netflix since Oct 3; 7 eps out (the latest aired Nov 14); episode count TBA
bench.about: MAPPA's faithful remake of Rumiko Takahashi's martial-arts rom-com: Ranma, cursed to turn into a girl when splashed with cold water, is betrothed to Akane and fends off a growing cast of rivals. Season 3 continues the manga.
bench.why: Quirky absurdist comedy with a supernatural-curse premise in 24-minute episodes. You haven't logged S1–S2 (24 eps, on Netflix), so a catch-up pick for the anime/comedy chips.
